privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Biopuhastid collects, uses, and protects personal information gathered through our website, contact forms, and related services.

overview.title: 1. Who we are
overview.body: Biopuhastid operates this website to present our wastewater solutions and collect enquiries. We are the data controller responsible for handling personal information received through this site.

collection.title: 2. Information we collect
collection.body: We collect contact details you submit (such as name, email, phone, organisation) as well as optional project details. We also collect limited technical data (like IP address and browser type) to secure the site and improve performance.

usage.title: 3. How we use information
usage.body: Submitted details are used to respond to enquiries, prepare proposals, and provide product information. Technical data helps maintain the site, troubleshoot issues, and measure aggregated traffic trends.

sharing.title: 4. When we share data
sharing.body: We only share personal data with trusted service providers that support our operations (for example email delivery or CRM tools). These partners process data under our instructions and do not sell or reuse it.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information. You can also object to processing or ask us to restrict use of your data. Contact us via the details below to exercise these rights.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about this policy or our data practices, contact Biopuhastid at info@example.ee or call +372 5555 5555.

meta.title: Rural Settlement Program 2026: Application Guide | BioPuhastid
meta.description: Clear guide for the 2026 Rural Settlement Program grant: eligibility, documents, deadlines. We help with quotes and the application package.

hero.description: Planning a bio-purifier or water system? Here's a clear guide on how to apply for up to €6,500 in support.

checklist.title: 1. Are you an eligible applicant?
items: You are a natural person and your permanent residence is in the household (as of 01.01.2026).
Residence is in a sparsely populated area (verify with local municipality).
You have no national or local tax debts (except rescheduled ones).
Reports for previous grants have been approved by the local municipality.

activities.title: 2. What is supported?

sewerage.title: Sewerage Systems
sewerage.desc: Support for external solutions for proper wastewater collection and treatment.

water.title: Water Supply Systems
water.desc: Construction or cleaning of borewells/dug wells, piping, and water treatment devices.

road.title: Access Roads
road.desc: Roads between private home and public road.

activities.note: * Support also available for access roads and autonomous electricity (if off-grid).

step1.title: Choose solution & get quotes
step1.desc: Think about what you need. Ask us for consultation and two comparable price quotes. This is mandatory.

step2.title: Prepare application package
step2.desc: Fill the application form, add budget, description of activities, and self-financing guarantee letter.

step3.title: Submit to Municipality (02.04)
step3.desc: Submit digitally signed application to your local municipality email by April 2nd.

step4.title: Decision & Execution
step4.desc: Decision is made in ~60 days. After signing the contract, you have until 31.10.2027 for works.

errors.title: Common Rejection Reasons
items: Missing 2 quotes or they are not comparable.
Indoor works: support is only for external systems.
Construction issues: missing easement or project doesn't meet requirements.

q1.q: When will I get the money?
q1.a: Support is usually paid after signing the grant agreement or after work completion.

q2.q: Can I do the work myself?
q2.a: Generally, a qualified contractor is required. DIY is allowed to a limited extent.

q3.q: What if the project gets more expensive?
q3.a: Support amount is fixed. Additional costs must be covered by the applicant.

q4.a: Only if crucial for household functioning (e.g., only washing place/toilet is there).
